memory_candidates.content: When a repo has a source store (agent-system/extensions/**) deployed into a disposable tree (.claude/**), any script that exists in BOTH locations at different directory depths cannot use a fixed levels-up climb to find the repo root. The depth-independent fix is `REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR" && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"` with the original fixed-depth climb retained only as an `if [[ -z "$REPO_ROOT" ]]` fallback for non-git checkouts -- behavior-preserving where git is absent, correct from every depth where git is present. Critically, planning such a migration must separate suites that FAIL from suites that merely CARRY the defect masked by a $SCRIPT_DIR-relative fallback candidate: the masked ones are only accidentally safe and are the recurrence surface, so eliminating the defect class means migrating all carriers, not just the loud ones. Also verify deployed-mode behavior cannot be established by editing the source store alone -- a redeploy is a separate gate, and where the deploy script is policy-restricted to manual invocation, an in-repo scratch copy placed at the deployed depth proves depth-independence without touching the deploy tree.
